_note: What the packaging and release scripts need to know about this module (packaging/module-info.ps1 reads it). The version is not here: it is the suite's, in shared/version.js. 'product' must match js/product.js. The tour's demo document is loaded on demand by the folder app, so the single-file build carries it inline (inlineExtras) to keep ?tour working with no sibling files. It reads and writes its own project file, spt-document, and Word files; it needs nothing from any other module.

tests._alone: Pages tools/run-tests.ps1 -Parallel runs on their own: hit-testing, scrolling and layout checks in the editor and the pages (fix-editor, editor, keys, tables, table-colours, fix-pages, speed), and test-doc-app, whose deliberate CPU-burning interval slows any page beside it.
